milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Rose bushes are placed at (-10, 0, 0) and (-11, 0, 1) in the western garden, 10+ blocks from spawn behind a hedge barrier at x=-3. Max distance 5 ensures the player actually navigated through the hedge doorway and walked to the garden rather than trivially satisfying from spawn. Facing tolerance 60° confirms the player is looking at the rose bush.

Uses inventory_has because mining dark oak leaves with shears (provided via /give) yields the leaf block as an item in inventory. Without shears, leaves drop saplings/sticks/nothing — never the block itself. The dark oak leaves are at y=2-3 near the tree trunk at (-8, 0-3, 4), reachable via the step-up stair at (-8,0,3). This is the most direct and unambiguous check for successful leaf mining.

Uses inventory_has because crafting mushroom stew (shapeless recipe: bowl + red_mushroom + brown_mushroom) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player must first break the red mushroom block at (-9,0,5) and brown mushroom block at (-7,0,5) to collect dropped items, then craft at the crafting table at (5,0,-3). Bowl is provided via /give. The crafted stew is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms task completion.

Uses inventory_has because crafting lime carpet results in the item appearing in inventory. This is a two-step craft: (1) white_wool + lime_dye → lime_wool, (2) 2 lime_wool horizontally → lime_carpet. Materials (4 white_wool, 4 lime_dye) are provided via /give. Crafting table is at (5,0,-3). Lime carpet is not in starting inventory so its presence is definitive proof of completion.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jungle pressure plate is at (2, 0, -11) inside the enclosed jungle wood structure (x=0-4, z=-13 to -9). Player must navigate north and enter through the doorway at (2,1,-9). Max distance 4 ensures the player is inside or at the entrance of the structure, not merely in the general area. Facing tolerance 60° confirms visual contact with the plate.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Fire burns on netherrack at (10, 1, 0), marking the ruins entrance. It is 10 blocks from spawn behind the east hedge barrier at x=3. Max distance 4 ensures the player navigated through the hedge and walked to the ruins entrance area. Facing tolerance 60° confirms the player is looking at the fire.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Mossy stone brick slabs are on the floor at (12, 0, 0) and (12, 0, 1) inside the ruins corridor. Player must enter through the doorway at (11,1,0). Max distance 3 ensures the player is inside the ruins (not just at the entrance), and facing tolerance 70° accounts for looking downward at floor-level slabs from eye height ~1.62.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The mossy cobblestone wall spans (14, 0-2, -1 to 1) at the deepest point of the ruins corridor. Player must walk past the mossy slabs at x=12 to reach x=14. Max distance 3 ensures the player is at the back of the ruins. Target is the wall center at (14, 1, 0). Facing tolerance 60° confirms visual contact.

Uses inventory_has because crafting light blue stained glass results in the item appearing in inventory. This is a multi-step process: (1) smelt sand with coal in furnace at (6,0,-3) to produce glass, (2) craft 8 glass + 1 light_blue_dye in 3x3 grid at crafting table (5,0,-3). Materials provided: 16 sand, 16 coal, 8 light_blue_dye. Light blue stained glass is not in starting inventory so its presence is definitive.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind=mob, max_count=0) because the task requires killing the enderman. The enderman is summoned at (14,1,0) with NoAI:1b (won't teleport or move) and PersistenceRequired:1b (won't despawn). Bounding box [10,-1,-4] to [16,5,4] tightly encloses the ruins structure (x=11-15, z=-3 to 3, y=0-4) with 1-block margin. Since doMobSpawning=false and the enderman has NoAI, it will remain in this box until killed. Max_count=0 means the milestone is satisfied only when the enderman is dead.
